reason: I already have a plumber, an electrician and a tutor I call, people my street or my cousin vouched for -- I don't need an app to find them for me, and switching to some stranger off a screen for the same job doesn't save me anything.
objection: Verification on an app is just a tick mark from a company I don't know -- it's not the same as my neighbour telling me this fellow did a good job in his house. If something goes wrong I want a person I can shout at, not a support ticket.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people I actually know -- my brother-in-law, a neighbour -- used it and told me it worked out fine and was cheaper, I'd try it once for something I don't already have a contact for, like a tutor for my daughter.
